adopted_question_verbatim: I'm trying to decide whether to buy a NAS device now or wait. What do you think?
adopted_answer_or_rubric_verbatim: 比较目前存储不足、外置硬盘与NAS需求，允许等待或购买两种合理结论。
english_rubric: Compare existing external backup, storage needs, central access and security. Waiting and buying may both be reasonable without a known budget.
authorization: User authorized adding an evidence-backed factual baseline while retaining adopted questions and their separate purposes.
